title: Juicy Peruvian Burrata Skillet
description: A winey and light Peruvian dish featuring burrata, mirepoix-base, and low-carb-friendly ingredients, cooked in a cast-iron skillet.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced bell pepper and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the white wine and cook until reduced by half, about 2 minutes.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes and cook until they start to release their juices, about 3 minutes.
Add the diced aji amarillo pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Place the burrata cheese in the center of the skillet and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 10-12 minutes, until the cheese is melted and the skillet is hot and bubbly.
